## [0.1.2] - 2026-10-27

### Added

- Added opt-in local and named G2Lex pronunciation sources with IPA validation and lexicon discovery
- Added contextual pronunciation overrides, heteronym resolution, and traceable pronunciation diagnostics

## [0.1.0] - 2026-10-01

### Added

- Added a frontend for prepared text that returns phoneme results and framed model IDs
- Added Kitten v0.8 symbol encoding, unknown-symbol reporting, and model-ID framing
- Added eSpeak phonemization through espeakng-runtime with native, CLI, and automatic modes
- Added caller-injected phoneme backends with caller-owned lifecycle semantics
- Added convenience phoneme and framed-ID functions and a JSON command
- Added a typing marker for typed consumers

### Documentation

- Documented installation, API, compatibility, and runnable examples

### Quality

- Improved release confidence with codec, lifecycle, CLI, dependency, and artifact checks
